integrity: Proof statements distinguish infinite-scale analytic bounds from finite reproducibility tests; historical equivalence remains a residual priority risk. No independent validation claimed.
limitations: Sharp constants for positive subcritical smoothness are characterized as one-dimensional maxima, without a closed-form list of their jump locations. The orbit measure convergence does not locate the initial jumps. Only the standard real interval Haar basis and weighted Hilbert energy are treated.
title: Sharp bounded-variation Haar energy: a midpoint transition and period-two critical law
